hero.headline: The people behind Project Chíp Chíp
hero.description: We are a group of students, graduates and engineers working to bring semiconductor knowledge closer to Vietnamese students.

mission.headline: It started with one question
mission.body: Why can a high-school student explain how a heart valve works, yet not how the chip inside the phone they carry every day is made? Semiconductors are everywhere, but the knowledge about them is scattered across English papers, university lectures and videos with no subtitles. Vietnamese students are not short of curiosity — they are short of a place to start. Project Chíp Chíp is that place: Vietnamese-language material, starting from the simplest idea, free for everyone.

team.headline: How we are organised
team.description: Project Chíp Chíp runs on eight units, each owning a distinct area. Gen 1.0 members will be introduced here once the roster is finalised.

leadership.name: Project Lead / Deputy
leadership.description: Owns the overall schedule, sets direction and keeps the project running day to day.

advisor.name: Subject Advisor
advisor.description: Guides the academic side and safeguards the accuracy and quality of everything published.

academic.name: Academic Team
academic.description: Designs the curriculum, writes survey forms, compiles the e-book and scripts content.

technology.name: Technology Team
technology.description: Designs, builds and operates the website and the project's other technical systems.

communications.name: Communications Team
communications.description: Runs the fanpage and other channels, plans campaigns and produces promotional content.

finance.name: Finance & Partnerships
finance.description: Prepares funding proposals, connects with companies and schools, and invites speakers and mentors.

people.name: People Team
people.description: Looks after members, tracks deadlines, manages records and issues certificates.

ambassador.name: Communications Ambassadors
ambassador.description: Spreads the word, connecting students in their schools and local communities.
